# Pitch developer documentation

> Pitch turns a product URL into a finished video. An AI agent opens a real browser, walks through
> the product, writes the script, records the screen, and renders an MP4. The same engine builds
> slide decks and cleans up screen recordings you already have.
>
> There are two ways in: an MCP server for AI agents, and a REST API for your own code. Both take
> the same API key and spend from the same credit balance.
>
> This file is the full developer documentation in one place. The same content, paginated, is at
> https://trypitch.co/docs

Base URL:      https://api.trypitch.co
MCP endpoint:  https://api.trypitch.co/mcp
MCP registry:  co.trypitch/pitch
API keys:      https://trypitch.co/api-keys
OpenAPI spec:  https://trypitch.co/openapi.json
Support:       support@trypitch.co


================================================================================
OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Two surfaces, one key.

                MCP                                REST
Endpoint        POST /mcp                          /v1/*
Use it when     an AI agent decides what to make   your code already knows
Shape           JSON-RPC tool calls                plain HTTP and JSON
Set up in       Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Perplexity  curl, any HTTP client

What you can make

  Output          What it is                                          Credits
  Demo video      the agent drives your live product and narrates     3
  Launch video    a scripted, scored, cinematic film                  6 to 13
  Deck            a slide deck written and designed from a topic      1
  Deck enhance    a redesign of a PDF or PPTX you upload              1
  Recording edit  a cut of a screen recording you already made        2

How a job runs

Every output is a job. You create it, we queue it, a worker picks it up. Creating a job returns
right away with an id. The work takes minutes, not milliseconds, so you poll for the result.

  create  ->  PENDING  ->  PROCESSING  ->  COMPLETED
                                \
                                 ->  FAILED

Credits come off the balance when the job is created, not when it finishes. If we fail to queue it,
we refund and mark it failed in the same step.


================================================================================
GETTING STARTED
================================================================================

1. Create an API key

Go to https://trypitch.co/api-keys and press Create key. Pitch keys start with pk_.

The full key is shown once. We store only its SHA-256 hash, so we cannot show it to you again or
recover it. Copy it somewhere safe. If you lose it, revoke it and make a new one.

The key acts as the user who made it. Jobs it creates belong to that user and spend that user's
credits.

2. Check your credits

  curl https://api.trypitch.co/v1/credits \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

  {
    "balance": 42,
    "plan": "pro",
    "transactions": [ ... ]
  }

A demo video costs 3 credits. If the balance is short, job creation fails with
402 insufficient_credits and nothing is charged.

3. Create a job

  curl -X POST https://api.trypitch.co/v1/videos \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
      "url": "https://trypitch.co",
      "instructions": "Walk through sign-up and the first render. Keep it under 60 seconds."
    }'

It answers 202 Accepted as soon as the job is queued.

  {
    "id": "cm4x8k2p90001abcd",
    "type": "video",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "progress": 0,
    "cost": 0,
    "videoUrl": null,
    "createdAt": "2026-09-02T10:14:03.221Z"
  }

4. Poll for the result

Ask for the job every few seconds until it stops being PENDING or PROCESSING. Ten seconds is a good
interval. Most videos land in a few minutes.

  curl https://api.trypitch.co/v1/jobs/cm4x8k2p90001abcd \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

  {
    "id": "cm4x8k2p90001abcd",
    "type": "video",
    "status": "COMPLETED",
    "progress": 100,
    "cost": 3,
    "videoUrl": "https://s3.trypitch.co/pitch/.../final.mp4",
    "thumbnailUrl": "https://s3.trypitch.co/pitch/.../thumb.jpg",
    "shareUrl": null,
    "error": null
  }

Download videoUrl and you are done.

The same thing in Node

  const KEY = process.env.PITCH_API_KEY
  const api = (path, init) =>
    fetch("https://api.trypitch.co" + path, {
      ...init,
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...init?.headers,
      },
    }).then(async r => {
      const body = await r.json()
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? r.statusText)
      return body
    })

  const job = await api("/v1/videos", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ url: "https://trypitch.co" }),
  })

  let state = job
  while (state.status === "PENDING" || state.status === "PROCESSING") {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 10_000))
    state = await api(`/v1/jobs/${job.id}`)
  }

  if (state.status === "FAILED") throw new Error(state.error)
  console.log(state.videoUrl)


================================================================================
AI AGENTS (MCP)
================================================================================

The server speaks the Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP. It is listed on the official MCP
registry as co.trypitch/pitch.

  Endpoint        POST https://api.trypitch.co/mcp
  Transport       Streamable HTTP, stateless
  Auth            Authorization: Bearer pk_...
  Registry name   co.trypitch/pitch

Stateless means every request stands alone. There is no session id and no server-sent stream to
hold open. GET and DELETE on /mcp return 405 Method Not Allowed on purpose.

Claude

  claude mcp add --transport http pitch \
    https://api.trypitch.co/mcp \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

In claude.ai: Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector.

Cursor

Settings, then MCP, then New server. Or edit .cursor/mcp.json:

  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "pitch": {
        "url": "https://api.trypitch.co/mcp",
        "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer pk_your_key" }
      }
    }
  }

ChatGPT

Settings, then Connectors, then Advanced, then Developer mode, then Add.

  URL     https://api.trypitch.co/mcp
  Header  Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key

The same connector works from the Responses and Agents APIs.

Perplexity

Settings, then Connectors, then Add connector, then Custom (MCP). Paste the endpoint and set the
auth header. The same setup works in Comet and the Perplexity API.

Any other client

If a client speaks Streamable HTTP and lets you set a header, it works.

  curl -X POST https://api.trypitch.co/mcp \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
    -d '{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list" }'

Most clients need the Accept header to include both application/json and text/event-stream. The MCP
SDK sets this for you.

Telling the agent how to behave

Agents tend to call a create tool and then stop, because the job is not finished yet. Put something
like this in your system prompt:

  When you use Pitch:
  - Call get_credits before a create tool so you know the job can pay for itself.
  - A create tool returns a jobId. The video is not ready at that point.
  - Poll get_job every 10 seconds until status is COMPLETED or FAILED.
  - On COMPLETED, give the user videoUrl or pdfUrl.
  - On FAILED, read the error field and say what went wrong.
  - Never call a create tool twice for the same request.

That last line matters. Every create tool spends credits at once, so a retried call is a second
charge, not a resumed job.


================================================================================
AUTHENTICATION
================================================================================

Getting a key

Sign in and open https://trypitch.co/api-keys. Press Create key, give it a name, and copy the value.
Keys look like pk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.

We store a SHA-256 hash of the key and the first 12 characters, nothing else. That prefix is what
you see in the list, so you can tell keys apart without us keeping the secret.

Sending it

Use a bearer token. This is the form to prefer everywhere.

  Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key

Some MCP clients only let you set a plain header with a plain value. For those, this also works:

  X-API-Key: pk_your_key

The two are equivalent. If both are present, Authorization wins.

What a key can do

A key acts as the user who created it. There are no scopes and no per-key limits yet. Anything that
user can do in the app, the key can do through the API, and every credit it spends lands in that
user's ledger next to their browser usage.

Revoking

Press Revoke on the keys page. It takes effect on the next request. Revoked keys stay in the list so
you can see what was in use and when it was last used.

Jobs already running under a revoked key keep running. Revoking stops new requests, it does not
cancel work in flight.

Keeping keys safe

  - Put keys in environment variables, never in source control.
  - Never ship a key to a browser or a mobile app. Call Pitch from your server.
  - Use one key per system, so you can revoke one without breaking the rest.
  - Rotate by making the new key first, switching over, then revoking the old one.

When auth fails

A missing, unknown, or revoked key returns 401 on both surfaces.

  { "error": { "code": "unauthorized", "message": "Invalid or revoked API key" } }

There is no way to tell those three cases apart from the response, on purpose.


================================================================================
CREDITS
================================================================================

What things cost

  Job type        REST                        MCP tool               Credits
  Demo video      POST /v1/videos             create_demo_video      3
  Launch video    POST /v1/launch-videos      create_launch_video    6 to 13
  Deck            POST /v1/decks              create_pdf             1
  Deck enhance    POST /v1/decks/enhance      enhance_presentation   1
  Recording edit  POST /v1/recordings/edit    edit_recording         2
  Any read        GET /v1/*                   get_*                  free

Launch video pricing

Launch videos are the one variable price. The resolution sets the base, and narration adds one
credit on top, because a narrated film needs a script and a voiceover clip per scene.

  Resolution        Narrated (default)   Music only
  720p              6                    5
  1080p (default)   9                    8
  4K                13                   12

If you send no resolution, you get 1080p and pay 9. An unrecognised value also falls back to 1080p
rather than the cheapest tier, so a typo can never underpay.

Reading the balance

  curl https://api.trypitch.co/v1/credits -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

  {
    "balance": 42,
    "plan": "pro",
    "transactions": [
      { "amount": -3, "reason": "Video generation", "jobId": "cm4x...", "createdAt": "..." },
      { "amount": 50, "reason": "Subscription renewal", "createdAt": "..." }
    ]
  }

The balance is the sum of the ledger, not a stored counter. transactions returns the 20 most recent
entries, newest first. Negative amounts are spend, positive are top-ups and refunds.

Checking a price first

  curl https://api.trypitch.co/v1/pricing

  {
    "video": 3,
    "deck": 1,
    "deck.enhance": 1,
    "recording.edit": 2,
    "launch_video": {
      "default": 9,
      "byResolution": {
        "720p":  { "narrated": 6,  "musicOnly": 5 },
        "1080p": { "narrated": 9,  "musicOnly": 8 },
        "4k":    { "narrated": 13, "musicOnly": 12 }
      }
    }
  }

This endpoint needs no key.

When you run out

We check the balance before creating anything. If it is short, the request fails with 402, no job is
made, and nothing is charged.

  {
    "error": {
      "code": "insufficient_credits",
      "message": "Not enough credits. Balance is 2. Buy more at https://trypitch.co/pricing.",
      "balance": 2
    }
  }

Over MCP the same case comes back as a tool error whose text carries the balance.

Refunds

Credits come off as soon as the job row is written. If the queue is unreachable at that moment, we
mark the job FAILED and put the exact amount back in the same step, so a broken queue never silently
eats credits.

A job that fails while a worker is running it is not refunded automatically. Email
support@trypitch.co if a job failed for a reason on our side.

Credits never expire.


================================================================================
FILES AND UPLOADS
================================================================================

Two jobs take a file you already have. Send it base64-encoded in the JSON body. There is no separate
upload step and no multipart form. This keeps MCP and REST identical, since an MCP tool call cannot
carry a multipart body.

Limits

  Job                                  Max size   Accepted
  Deck enhance    POST /v1/decks/enhance      50 MB     .pdf .pptx
  Recording edit  POST /v1/recordings/edit   500 MB     .mp4 .webm .mov .mkv .avi

Sizes are measured after decoding. Base64 is about a third larger than the raw file, so a 500 MB
video is roughly a 667 MB request body. The type is read from the extension in fileName, not from
the bytes.

Sending a file

  curl -X POST https://api.trypitch.co/v1/decks/enhance \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$(jq -n --arg f "$(base64 -w0 deck.pdf)" \
      '{ fileBase64: $f, fileName: "deck.pdf", mode: "recreate" }')"

In Node:

  import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
  const file = await readFile("recording.mp4")

  await fetch("https://api.trypitch.co/v1/recordings/edit", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.PITCH_API_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      fileBase64: file.toString("base64"),
      fileName: "recording.mp4",
      productName: "Acme",
      productUrl: "https://acme.com",
      instructions: "Cut the dead air at the start. Add intro and outro cards.",
    }),
  })

What happens to your file

We decode it to a temp file, check the extension and size, upload it to object storage, and delete
the temp copy. The stored input is what the worker reads. Output files live in the same bucket and
are served over HTTPS.

Assets for a demo video

Demo videos take assets differently. You pass assets, an array of public URLs to PDFs or images, and
we fetch them.

  { "url": "https://trypitch.co", "assets": ["https://example.com/brand-guide.pdf"] }

Passing assets changes the flow. The job plans first and stops at AWAITING_REVIEW so a human can
approve the plan in the app before it records. Scripts that expect a video to appear on its own will
hang.

Errors

  413  payload_too_large        the decoded file is over the limit for that job
  415  unsupported_media_type   the extension is not in the accepted list
  400  invalid_request          the base64 decoded to nothing


================================================================================
POLLING JOBS
================================================================================

Statuses

  PENDING           queued, no worker has picked it up yet          keep polling
  PROCESSING        a worker is on it                               keep polling
  AWAITING_REVIEW   planning done, a human must approve in the app  stop, it will not move
  COMPLETED         done, the result URL is populated               stop
  FAILED            something broke, error says what                stop

AWAITING_REVIEW only happens on a demo video created with assets. If your script does not handle it,
it will poll forever. Treat it as terminal and tell the user to approve the plan in the dashboard.

How often

Every 10 seconds is right. Faster does not make the render faster. Demo videos usually finish in a
few minutes, launch videos take longer because they run a full recon, script, build, and mix pass.

A loop that handles every case

  const TERMINAL = ["COMPLETED", "FAILED", "AWAITING_REVIEW"]

  async function waitFor(jobId, { intervalMs = 10_000, timeoutMs = 30 * 60_000 } = {}) {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs

    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const res = await fetch(`https://api.trypitch.co/v1/jobs/${jobId}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.PITCH_API_KEY}` },
      })

      // Transient. Wait and try again rather than giving up on the job.
      if (res.status >= 500) {
        await sleep(intervalMs)
        continue
      }
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).error.message)

      const job = await res.json()
      if (TERMINAL.includes(job.status)) return job

      await sleep(intervalMs)
    }

    throw new Error(`Job ${jobId} did not finish in time`)
  }

  const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))

Progress

progress is a number from 0 to 100. It is a weighted sum of finished phases, not a time estimate, so
it moves in jumps. phases lists what the worker is doing.

  {
    "status": "PROCESSING",
    "progress": 70,
    "phases": [
      { "phase": "workspace_init",        "label": "Workspace Initialization", "status": "completed" },
      { "phase": "video_recording",       "label": "Video Recording",          "status": "completed" },
      { "phase": "ffmpeg_postprocessing", "label": "FFmpeg Post-Processing",   "status": "running"   },
      { "phase": "intro_outro",           "label": "Intro & Outro Cards",      "status": "pending"   }
    ]
  }

Different job types run different phases. Do not hardcode the list, read the labels.

Where the result lands

  video           videoUrl
  launch_video    videoUrl
  recording.edit  videoUrl
  deck            pdfUrl
  deck.enhance    pdfUrl

Videos also get a thumbnailUrl. shareUrl is set only if someone turned on sharing for that job in
the app.

Listing jobs

  curl "https://api.trypitch.co/v1/jobs?type=video&limit=10" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

Launch video detail

Launch videos are also projects, addressed by the name you gave them. Once the worker has built the
workspace you can read the scene breakdown, which is more useful than a percentage.

  curl https://api.trypitch.co/v1/launch-videos/acme-launch \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_your_key"

  {
    "name": "acme-launch",
    "hasVideo": true,
    "videoUrl": "https://s3.trypitch.co/renders/acme-launch-launch.mp4",
    "sceneCount": 5,
    "duration": 58.4,
    "scenes": [
      { "id": "s1", "index": 1, "start": 0, "end": 6.2, "dur": 6.2, "vo": "Meet Acme.", "draftUrl": null }
    ]
  }


================================================================================
ERRORS
================================================================================

Every REST failure has the same shape and a stable code. Match on the code, not the message.

  {
    "error": {
      "code": "insufficient_credits",
      "message": "Not enough credits. Balance is 2. Buy more at https://trypitch.co/pricing.",
      "balance": 2
    }
  }

code and message are always present. Some codes add a field, like balance above. Messages are
written for people and may change. Codes will not.

Codes

  400  invalid_request         a field is missing, the wrong type, or out of range. The message
                               names the field. Fix the body, retrying will not help.
  401  unauthorized            the key is missing, unknown, or revoked.
  402  insufficient_credits    the balance cannot cover the job. Nothing was created or charged.
                               Top up, then retry the same request.
  404  not_found               no job or project with that id, or it belongs to someone else.
  413  payload_too_large       the decoded file is over the limit.
  415  unsupported_media_type  the extension is not accepted for that job.
  500  internal_error          something broke on our side. Retry with backoff.

What is safe to retry

There are no idempotency keys yet, so a retried create is a second job and a second charge. Retry
writes only when you never got a response at all, and check the job list first.

  GET                              yes, always safe
  400, 401, 402, 404, 413, 415     no, fix the cause first
  500 on a read                    yes, with backoff
  500 on a create                  check GET /v1/jobs first, the job may exist
  no response, timeout             same, list jobs before firing again

Job failure is not an HTTP error

A job that fails while rendering still returns 200. The failure is in the body.

  {
    "id": "cm4x8k2p90001abcd",
    "status": "FAILED",
    "error": "Navigation timed out after 30s: https://example.com is unreachable",
    "videoUrl": null
  }

Common causes: the URL is behind a login, blocked our browser, or was down. Sites that need a
sign-in cannot be demoed from a public URL alone.

Errors over MCP

MCP has no status codes. A failed tool call returns a normal result with isError: true and the
message as text, so the agent can read it and react.

  {
    "isError": true,
    "content": [
      { "type": "text", "text": "Insufficient credits: your current balance is 2. Buy more at https://trypitch.co/pricing, then retry." }
    ]
  }

A bad key is the exception. That fails before MCP is reached, so the client sees a plain 401 and
usually reports the server as unreachable.


================================================================================
REST API REFERENCE
================================================================================

  Base URL          https://api.trypitch.co
  Auth              Authorization: Bearer pk_...
  Content type      application/json
  Create response   202 Accepted with a job object

The job object

  id            string          use it to poll
  type          string          video | launch_video | deck | deck.enhance | recording.edit
  status        string          PENDING | PROCESSING | AWAITING_REVIEW | COMPLETED | FAILED
  progress      number          0 to 100
  cost          number          credits charged, 0 until the worker settles it
  videoUrl      string | null   set when a video job completes
  pdfUrl        string | null   set when a deck job completes
  thumbnailUrl  string | null   poster frame for videos
  shareUrl      string | null   only if sharing was turned on in the app
  error         string | null   set when status is FAILED
  phases        array           phase, label, status
  createdAt     string          ISO 8601
  updatedAt     string          ISO 8601

POST /v1/videos          3 credits

  url            string    required   public product URL
  instructions   string    optional   what to show, tone, length
  script         string    optional   your own narration, one is written if omitted
  voice          string    optional   voice id
  assets         string[]  optional   public URLs to PDFs or images. Triggers AWAITING_REVIEW

POST /v1/launch-videos   6 to 13 credits

  name           string    required   project name, unique per user. No / or \, no leading dot
  prompt         string    required   creative brief: product, audience, tone, length
  music          string    optional   track filename from the shared library
  resolution     string    optional   720p | 1080p (default) | 4k. Sets the price
  narration      boolean   optional   default true. False saves 1 credit

POST /v1/decks           1 credit

  topic          string    required
  instructions   string    optional

POST /v1/decks/enhance   1 credit, max 50 MB, .pdf .pptx

  fileBase64     string    required   base64 of the file
  fileName       string    required   the extension decides the type
  mode           string    optional   recreate (default) rebuilds it, preserve keeps the layout
  enhancePrompt  string    optional   what to change
  slideCount     number    optional   target slide count in recreate mode

POST /v1/recordings/edit  2 credits, max 500 MB, .mp4 .webm .mov .mkv .avi

  fileBase64     string    required   base64 of the video
  fileName       string    required   the extension decides the type
  productName    string    optional   used on the intro card
  productUrl     string    optional   used on the outro card
  instructions   string    optional   guidance for the editor

GET /v1/jobs             free

  type   query   video | launch_video | deck | deck.enhance | recording.edit
  limit  query   default 50, max 100

  { "data": [ { "id": "cm4x...", "type": "video", "status": "COMPLETED", ... } ], "total": 37 }

GET /v1/jobs/{id}        free. 404 if it does not exist or is not yours.

GET /v1/launch-videos    free

  { "data": [ { "name": "acme-launch", "hasVideo": true, "videoUrl": "...", "sceneCount": 5 } ] }

GET /v1/launch-videos/{name}  free. One project with its scene breakdown.

GET /v1/credits          free. Balance, plan, and the 20 most recent ledger entries.

GET /v1/pricing          free, no key. Current credit prices.

Not there yet

Being straight about the edges: there are no webhooks, so you have to poll. There are no idempotency
keys, so a retried create is a second charge. There is no cursor pagination on job lists, only a
limit. There is no way to cancel a running job through the API. Email support@trypitch.co if you
need one of these.


================================================================================
MCP TOOLS REFERENCE
================================================================================

Every tool returns a JSON string in a text block. Create tools return { "jobId", "status" }. Read
tools return the object. On failure the result has isError: true.

create_demo_video        3 credits
  url            string    required
  instructions   string    optional
  script         string    optional
  voice          string    optional
  assets         string[]  optional

create_launch_video      6 to 13 credits
  name           string    required   project name, unique per user
  prompt         string    required   creative brief
  music          string    optional   track from the shared library
  resolution     string    optional   720p | 1080p | 4k
  narration      boolean   optional   default true

create_pdf               1 credit
  topic          string    required
  instructions   string    optional

enhance_presentation     1 credit, max 50 MB
  fileBase64     string    required
  fileName       string    required
  mode           string    optional   recreate | preserve
  enhancePrompt  string    optional
  slideCount     number    optional

edit_recording           2 credits, max 500 MB
  fileBase64     string    required
  fileName       string    required
  productName    string    optional
  productUrl     string    optional
  instructions   string    optional

get_job                  free. Takes jobId. This is what the agent polls.

list_jobs                free. Optional type: video | pdf | enhance | edit-recording.
                         Note these are the older internal names and differ from the REST ones.
                         REST uses deck where MCP uses pdf.

get_launch_video         free. Takes name. Scenes, durations, and the render URL when ready.

list_launch_videos       free. All launch video projects for the key owner.

get_credits              free. Balance, subscription, and transactions. Call it before a create tool.
